name: code-python
description: code-python is a benchmark for evaluating Python code generation and correctness of model-produced programs, typically by executing generated code against reference tests or unit tests. It measures functional correctness, robustness across problem types, and models' ability to produce runnable Python solutions. The dataset is used to compare code-generation models and reward models on Python tasks.
reputation: A specialized dataset within the multilingual-reward-bench collection used by researchers working on code generation and reward modeling; moderate niche adoption.
